highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 delivers a focused performance sprint and the Skia m151 engine update.
highlights_body: This release ports several hot-path computations to managed C# to eliminate P/Invoke overhead, makes HarfBuzz text shaping allocation-free on common paths, adds .NET 11 WASM support via Emscripten 5.0.6, and incorporates multiple rounds of upstream Skia m151 stability fixes.

bullets.detail: The bundled Skia engine has been updated to milestone m151, and multiple rounds of upstream chrome/m151 stability and bug fixes have been merged.
SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT was restored to fix a CPU raster quality regression introduced by the m151 upgrade.

bullets.lead: SKColor hex parsing optimized with new ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads
bullets.detail: Hex color parsing is now allocation-free and faster; new ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads are available for callers that already have span-based strings.
The unnecessary unsafe modifier has been removed from GRContextOptions, making the type usable without enabling unsafe code.

bullets.lead: Native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) fixed
bullets.detail: A native handle was leaked when creating a cropped image from encoded data; it is now correctly released.

bullets.lead: Performance: SKColor/SKColorF and SKPMColor conversions moved to managed code
bullets.detail: SKColor-to-SKColorF conversion and single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply are now pure managed integer arithmetic, eliminating per-call P/Invoke overhead.

bullets.lead: Performance: SKShaper glyph reads via zero-copy spans
bullets.detail: SKShaper now reads glyph results through zero-copy spans rather than marshalling arrays, reducing per-shaping allocations.

bullets.lead: Performance: SKFourByteTag.Parse char array allocation eliminated
bullets.detail: SKFourByteTag.Parse no longer allocates a char[4] on each call.
New static libraries built with Emscripten 5.0.6 enable SkiaSharp on .NET 11 WASM, including support for the new exnref exception-handling model.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Bumped the Skia WASM submodule to drop an SK_BUILD_FOR_WASM redefinition warning, added Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM libraries for .NET 11, and contributed to test infrastructure

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: Release Candidate 1 delivered the Skia m151 upstream stability round, WASM .NET 11 Emscripten 5.0.6 libraries, and a preview WASM test job to catch exception-handling regressions.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 focused on the HarfBuzz performance sprint: AddUtf8 and Tag.Parse are now allocation-free, SKShaper reads glyphs via zero-copy spans, and another m151 stability sync landed.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the 4.151.0 line with the Skia m151 engine update and a WASM fix to drop a build-define redefinition warning.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 makes the two hottest text-shaping paths allocation-free: Buffer.AddUtf8 now pools its UTF-8 encoding buffer and Tag.Parse no longer allocates a char[4] per call.
